children: Zilliqa's self-guided ZKP migration tool rolls out once the hard fork activates the required escrow contract, giving legacy ZIL holders a path to move funds to the Zilliqa EVM. The tool's audit is complete and internal testing is underway ahead of release.

The activation on 22 September gives investors a concrete date for restoring access to stranded tokens. Because the tool is self-guided and depends on the escrow contract going live with the hard fork, migration becomes available without a manual intermediary step, and the release signals resumed execution of the ZKP roadmap. Holders can confirm the hard fork has activated before starting a migration, since the escrow contract is the dependency for the tool.
The ZKP migration tool audit is complete, and internal testing is underway.
Rollout is targeted for 22 September, when the second hard fork activates the required escrow contract.

title: Zilliqa: ZKP migration tool rolls out with hard fork escrow contract - 22 Sep 2026
